Center anything with Flexbox
Undo last commit (keep changes)
content:
git reset --soft HEAD~1

  # Then re-stage and commit again:
  git add .
  git commit -m "Updated commit message"

title: Find and kill process by port
content:
# Find process using port 3000
  lsof -i :3000

  # Kill the process
  kill -9 $(lsof -t -i:3000)

  # One-liner alternative:
  fuser -k 3000/tcp
